div.div: مَقْذَرٌ (assumed tropical:) One whom others avoid, or shun: (S, K:) occurring in a Hudhalee poem: (S:) or i. q. ↓ مُتَقَذِّرٌ [one who shuns, avoids, or removes himself far from, unclean things, or foul actions; who preserves himself therefrom]. (K.) See also قُذَرَةٌ, and قَذُورٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
